cohort: 3,635 nulliparous women aged 35 years or older delivering vaginally a singleton, vertex neonate.
finding: Epidural anesthesia was negatively associated with OASI, while birthweight and hypertensive disorders were positively associated with OASI in nulliparous women of advanced maternal age.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was higher in the OASI group (39 6/7 weeks) compared to the no-OASI group (39 1/7 weeks).
birth_weight: Mean birthweight was higher in the OASI group (3,286 g) compared to the no-OASI group (3,059 g).
